_meta.what: Labelled buyer DMs for the Apex Gardens (DEMO) estate. Invented by Propel, no real person's message. 'expect' lists every acceptable rule_id; NONE means the right move is to hand the message to the brain.

kinds.exact: uses a trigger phrase; checks Jev does not make the easy cases worse
kinds.paraphrase: same meaning, no trigger phrase; the cases Jev is meant to recover
kinds.typo: misspelt the way phone keyboards misspell
kinds.offtopic: nothing a card can answer; must go to the brain
kinds.injection: tries to talk the bot out of its rules

_meta.rule: Add cases, never delete them. The exam only gets harder.
